description: Figure 5 illustrates the average number of likes received by headlines categorized by season groups. The horizontal axis represents the season groups—Winter, Spring, Summer, and Fall—listed in that order and labeled as “Season groups.” The vertical axis, labeled “Avg. likes (likes/N=2)”, represents the average number of likes, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 600, and tick marks at 100-unit intervals. Four bars are displayed, one for each season group, and they are colored in shades of blue, ranging from light to dark. The Winter bar is the shortest, with a height of approximately 260 likes. The Spring bar is slightly taller, reaching approximately 360 likes. The Summer bar is the tallest, measuring approximately 540 likes. The Fall bar has a height of approximately 450 likes. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation, and are arranged in the order of the seasons.
